_comment: Gemini CLI MCP config for Thalamus. Merge the mcpServers block below into your .gemini/settings.json (project-local) or ~/.gemini/settings.json (global). Edit the FILL-IN values. Launch `gemini` from the root of the repo you want the brain scoped to (--repo .). If your password is not the local-dev default, change THALAMUS_NEO4J_PASSWORD. HF_HUB_OFFLINE is 0 because the first run must download the BGE-small encoder from the Hugging Face Hub; set it to 1 once the model is cached to keep the server off the network.
